title: Full Stack Developer: one vertical slice, table to screen
intro: A full stack developer owns a feature through every layer: table, API, UI, tests, release. Build one thin slice completely before building wide.
outcome: A working resource: table, validated API, typed UI, tests, and a release checklist run.

steps.title: Plan the work: requirements, method, tests
steps.what: Decide what to build, how, and how you will prove it before coding.
how: Open Software engineering > Requirements: paste a user story and fix every vague word.
List requirements and tests in the traceability matrix until every must-have has a test.
Open Process and pick a method with the chooser; note why.
Use Pseudocode to draw the algorithm before you code it.
steps.done_when: Every must-have requirement has at least one test and you can say why you chose the method.
mistakes: Tests that map to no requirement.
steps.ask: Review my user stories for vague or untestable wording.

steps.title: Map the API you have
steps.what: Know the contract before changing it.
how: Open API map & tester and browse groups.
Use a GET on one endpoint and read the JSON.
Open /docs on the backend for the OpenAPI view.
steps.done_when: You can describe 3 endpoints without looking.
steps.ask: Explain how this API is organised.

steps.title: Design the resource
how: Open the Star schema page for the existing model.
Decide columns, types and a primary key for the new table.
Prototype the queries in SQL Lab.
steps.done_when: A table definition you could defend.
steps.ask: Design a table for this feature.

steps.title: Scaffold the layers
steps.what: Generate a first draft of every layer.
how: Open Scaffold from a table and pick a table.
Read each generated file.
Check every value is a ? parameter, never glued into SQL.
steps.done_when: You read and understood each file.
mistakes: Pasting generated code you haven't read.
steps.ask: Review this generated router for problems.

steps.title: Register and run it
steps.what: Wire the router into the app.
how: Paste the router into backend/app/routers.
Add include_router in app/main.py.
Restart the backend.
steps.done_when: The endpoint appears in the API map.
steps.ask: How do I register a router?

steps.title: Try it and break it
how: Use the tester: GET, POST, PUT, DELETE (Practice only).
Send a bad body and read the 422.
Check a missing id returns 404.
steps.ask: What bad inputs should I try?

steps.title: Write real tests
how: Use the generated pytest skeleton.
Assert the status and the data.
Run pytest from backend.
steps.done_when: A failing test exists for a broken case, then passes.

steps.title: Build the screen
steps.what: Handle loading, empty, error and success.
how: Use the generated React panel as a start.
Copy its pattern from PmPanel.tsx.
Add the TypeScript type.
steps.done_when: The screen shows all four states.
steps.ask: Review my React panel for missing states.

steps.title: Review code health
steps.what: Look for the file doing too many jobs.
how: Open Codebase: largest files and test ratio.
steps.done_when: You noted the largest file and one split.
steps.ask: How could I split my largest file?

steps.title: Run the release checklist
how: Open Stack & config; read each fact.
Tests green, backup taken, .env ignored, CORS has no wildcard.
steps.ask: Walk me through a release checklist.
